title: NAS-5GS: Implement stub IEs per TS 24.501 v19.6.2
description:
Implement dissection for SM information elements that were previously
  showing "IE not dissected yet":

  - 9.11.4.29 Remote UE context list (5G ProSe relay)
  - 9.11.4.30 Requested MBS container (multicast join/leave)
  - 9.11.4.31 Received MBS container (multicast decisions)
  - 9.11.4.36 N3QAI (non-3GPP access QoS parameters)
  - 9.11.4.37 Non-3GPP delay budget
  - 9.11.4.38 URSP rule enforcement reports
  - 9.11.4.39 Protocol description (UL PDU set / RTP)
  - 9.11.4.41 Non-3GPP device information

AI-Assisted: yes (Kiro)
